[b]The People's Republic of Astanir[/b]

Victory was imminent. The Astaniran people could feel it. In these bombed out homes and on the streets that had split open through the sheer intensity of missile and rocket fire and across the polluted rivers and its rat-infested landfills with its starving children collecting recyclable junk to be sold for the barest scrap, the lowest, weak, and dying dregs of the human race were slowly but surely unifying behind the feeling that the end was near.

Horano Benir, Chairman of the Committee of Executives of the Democratic Council (CEDC) was quite well-aware of this, and in the morning of 17 June 2026, he would humbly ask all non-Astaniran members of the CEDC government to resign their posts. David Cyriacus and Yun Caibo, the seniormost of these "foreign" officials, would quickly accede and have all subordinate foreigners also resign, at last leaving CEDC with an all-Astaniran regime. After all, these Qianxun, Sanguinian, and Vespurian advisors had already taken up position in QASIC. 

Their continued meddling in the Astaniran Democratic government itself was no longer warranted or needed.

After a brief meeting with the rump CEDC, Benir receive consensus that time was now right to formally abolish the Democratic Council and all Arono-era institutions and to make provision for the creation of a new Astaniran state. At conference of senior officials in the capital city of Astan, Benir would proclaim the formation of the "Astaniran supreme power", a provisional technocratic government that was to map out the popular vision of the post-civil war Astanir, inviting the entire Democratic movement, the popular committees, and the non-affiliated citizenry to elect representatives in their respective localities to prepare a Constituent Assembly that was to draft a new constitution.

Until matters could be resolved, this new state is to be called the "People's Republic of Astanir", and was to operate along a "socially-conscious political line" to ensure the rapid upliftment of Astanir's beleagured, traumatized, and hapless populace after all these years of brutal civil war, internal strife, corruption, and national degradation.

To this end, the Benir government would ask the international community to recognize the People's Republic of Astanir "sole successor to the rights and obligations" previously beholden to the still technically extent Astaniran Republic. The Tribal Republic of Kuhaw-Astan, an ally of the Benirist government, would by comparison be declared to be a completely new entity, not representative of the Shamatine Astaniran nation but rather of its substantial Argossian minority, which had previously fought as an independent belligerent due to years of abuse by Astanir's dictatorial governments long past.

Even more specifically, Horano Benir would ask the nations of Erene to adopt a policy of non-recognition towards the Daesunian-dominated United Democratic Forces, a paramilitary group currently occupying the Astaniran Southern Islands. (https://i.imgur.com/4i7a2k0.png). On its exact reasoning for this appeal, the Benirsts would list a number of key points:

[list=1][*]In occupying the Southern Islands, UDF forces [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=rmb/postid=60453738]instigated ethnic cleansing operations[/url] to eradicate the islands' native Argossian minorities, which constituted genocide.

[*]The UDF, being an Amaralo-centric paramilitary force, is openly racist, supremacist, extremist, and imperialist. It has no goals of uplifting the Astaniran nation, rather expediting the prompt separation of the ethno-state they've crafted into the Daesunian sphere of influence.

[*]The government of Daesun, which is the UDF's foremost patron, had illegally declared these islands to be one large "humanitarian zone", which operates in direct contravention to Astaniran sovereignty.

[*]Daesun has encouraged UDF units to maintain substantial military forces within this "humanitarian zone" until such time that their seccession can be made into [i]fait accompli[/i] by the international community.

[*]The People's Republic of Astanir presently controls the national capital and the overwhelming majority of state institutions. Through this, it has provided social breakthroughs, in the conducting of local elections, the resolution to the Llyndorran flu that has tormented the city of Astan, the rebuilding of Astanir's war-torn cities, and the resumption of commercial enterprise during the nation's darkest hour.[/list]

Having resolved that all these stated points were truths, with objectively verifiable evidence of their occurences through Nordiheimian accounts of the rescue of Argossian tribes fleeing UDF persecution, Sanguinian records of Daesun's aggressive diplomatic conduct on QASIC's attempts to halt shipments to the UDF, and Daesun's own public proclamations of the so-called humanitarian safe zone, the Benir govenrment would appeal all the "anti-imperialist powers" of Erene to refuse recognition of the UDF and its military occupation of the Southern Islands.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]QASIC summer phase offensive[/b]]

[b]QASIC summer phase offensive[/b]

David Cyriacus would receive glowing reports of QASIC's advances made in the north and south. In exactly a single night, the entire frontline of the Isolationist armed forces have collapsed, equipment on the lines completely abandoned, entire storehouses filled with MREs, canned goods, and grain have been left unattended. Hundreds of thosuands of soldiers were fleeing en masse to their second, third, fourth lines of defense, completely and utterly swamping the Isolationists' already strained logistics and supply trains just as QASIC prepared yet another push the next day.

On the flipside, however, despite the overwhelming success of their initial offensive, Cyriacus noted that QASIC was behind schedule. In the very center of the formation, Freya Moran's 1st Maneuver Army had trouble making advances against the sheer density of Isolationist trenchworks, pillboxes, bunkers, and barbed wire. The same seems to have transpired in Operation Menghuan, where Restorationist forces had effectively dug-in against the 3rd and 6th Maneuver Armies despite anticipation of their weakness after all these months of inaction against the lethargic Isolationist armed forces.

And yet, so what? In just a single night, QASIC forces have stormed through about 200 kilometers of land. These roads and bridges that were to become the speartip of the Isolationist armed forces' counteroffensive were now greeting the tracks of Qianxun tanks, self-propelled guns, and trucks. Victory was certain now. The Isolationist frontlines have completely and utterly collapsed. There was no soldier on the enemy lines who possessed instructions to fight in pursuit of triumph. Their orders were to remain in their pillboxes and hope that at the hour of their defeat, they'd die knowing that they've made QASIC bled every single step of the way. 

However, even this, Cyriacus would deny.

To properly leverage their aerial superiority, Wuying-89 fighter jets would be ordered to refit their armaments. Conventional 500kg bombs and 122 mm rockets would be swapped out in favor of fresh units filled up with thermobaric filler. The cast-cured PBX, aluminum powder, and gelled fuels necessary for such weapons would be crafted from Astaniran chemical plants in Democratic territory, with materials supplied by Tencor's Oil Row. While less reliable than conventional high explosive on open ground, heavier, and problematic to store, thermobaric filler excelled in the trenches and other confined geometries where its afterburning and pressure waves would be the most effective at puncturing ear drums, rupturing lungs, and rendering entire trench systems uninhabitable.

Next, QASICOCEAN and 5th Man. Army were to now fully commit to a massive push in the southern coastline. Without any air support and naval reinforcements to possibly aid the Isolationists in the south, Bai He's 5th Man. Army would run into virtually no resistance in their advance through the Astaniran coastal territories, with naval missiles and drones clearing out entire kilometers of trench networks before they could even catch sight of QASIC ground forces. 

The hope now was to sweep past these bombed out defenses to sweep through the southern flank of the Isolationist forces, turn north and smash into them on two sides. Isolationist forces will either need to execute a complicated rearrangement of their forces to face Bai He's force and risk getting completely overrun by the 1st and 2nd Man. Armies, or else holdfast and become victims of what may very well be the largest encirclement in modern military history.

Last but not least, Freya Moran and Edwin Roylance would organize a unit of special operations forces called "Eureka Group" (after Moran's callsign) to infiltrate deep into the Isolationist armed forces' enemy lines. Totaling around 2,268 men from the SummitONE Corps of Commissionaires, these special forces would work in detachments of 12 men each, either dropping via helicopter into Isolationist territory or walking on foot through breaches in the Isolationist trench systems created by the QASIC offensive. Expected to work up to 300 kilometers beyond the frontlines, these spec ops units were tasked with digging up and destroying fiber optic lines, destroying unexploded ordnance to prevent tech capture, rescuing downed pilots, calling CAS against enemy fortifications and artillery systems, and simulating encircling raids to draw enemy forces away from the frontlines. 

In the mean time, 1st and 2nd Man. Armies would keep up the pressure. Certainly the Isolationist forces in the center of the lines were the densest, yet these same lines were now being overrun by their own fleeing forces, without supplies, logistical disruptions by SummitONE special forces, and now intense bunk-busting operations and thermobaric bombardments by QASICAIR forces, the overwhelming range and reconaissance advantage of QASIC artillery fire, relentless coastal and drone bombardments. In Freya Moran's own words, "It was like one massive turkey shoot, with targets that never seemed to run out."[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Argos Strait Confrontation[/b]]

[b]Argos Strait Confrontation[/b]

As the Daesunians would continue to send their ships over to UDF territory, they would be "escorted" throughout the entire journey by Sanguinian military boats and drones, which would keep track of the exact composition of the Daesunians' aid relative to the strengths of the UDF islands. Though, with Daesunian allies currently preoccupied with other matters, the overwhelming numbers advantage of QASIC forces, and the imminent collapse of all anti-Democratic factions in the Mainland, prospects for the UDF seemed rather grim.

Collectively, the UDF-held islands formed a total land territory of roughly 1,400 square kilometers spread out over four islands of varying topography. Historically, these islands relied heavily on the Mainland and on foreign investment for aid, best exemplified at the moment by its enduring reliance on Daesunian shipments to feed its solitary population. With the People's Republic of Astanir now proclaimed, however, the Sanguinians now began to prepare its drafting of a final military offensive to expel the UDF forces from the islands once and for all.

For now, drones would fly over UDF territory whenever possible to get a good look at its military installations, if the UDF even had any time to setup any that were substantial given the rapid pace of events. All the while, training exercises would be run by the QASICOCEAN forces, which by now had accumulated in the South of Astanir bearing down ominously over the entire Astaniran area of responsibility on all sides, ready and waiting for the final campaign of the civil war.[/spoiler][/quote]

[i](Not gonna write anything for the peoples republic and the Argos strait, as they are both in your hands and dont require input from the other factions)[/i]

[b]The summer offensive[/b]
Pushes in the north and south would continue to be successful for QASIC as Isolationist line became thinner and thinner. The offensive would push the isolationists into central positions which could quickly be encircled and overwhelmed, which would allow QASIC to continue pushing forward with great pace.

Desertion rates within the isolationists would now be at an all-time high, leaving the frontlines practically empty apart from the occasional soldier that had been brainwashed to the point that they would simply stay put and die for the lost cause. This would Allow democrats to flood into and seize more central territory of central Astanir

These new thermobaric filler bombs would prove effective against the deep isolationist trenches. The isolationists only solid defence against QASIC would now become useless, rendering them completely vulnerable to the ground offensive if they even survived the initial bombing.

The huge encirclement of isolationist troops would be successful in rounding them into a central position, which would be easily overrun. With trenches now lining limited areas of the frontlines, and the thermobaric bombs taking care of them, the isolationist army would be helpless to the might of QASIC. Most would surrender, whilst those that still possessed any nationalist spirit would simply die in combat. Some would try to escape, but the encirclement would halt them in their tracks. The isolationist cause was lost and everyone knew it.

The QASICOCEAN push along the southern coastline would be executed with ease. The isolationists would now, for the most part, be trapped in positions far way from the coast thanks to earlier attacks in the south. Practically the entire southern coastline would come under the control of QASIC thanks to the naval push.

The eureka group would deal the finishing blow to the isolationists. Infiltration deep behind the frontline defences would give the isolationists no chance of survival. Their trenches were now useless and able to be bypassed, they were surrounded with no access to the coast and their fighting spirit was all but gone.

The pressure given by the 1st and 2nd man. armies would hardly be needed due to the previous operations. The two armies would simply bolster QASICs offensive, causing them to destroy the isolationists even quicker.

The final isolationist soldiers would surrender to QASIC forces after around 4 days of the encirclement and attack inwards. The peoples republic would now be in total control of the southern mainland.

General Kaiwai would be declared KIA initially, but he would have used one of the isolationists only helicopters to escape the attack during the night, along with his top generals and advisors, leaving behind his loyal soldiers to the mercy of QASIC. The helicopter would be equipped with little stealth technology, making it susceptible to QASIC radar and satellite detection.

[b]Northern Troubles[/b]
Haru Aronos splinter faction had been sitting dormant just north of the democrats for some time now, but with QASIC forces all concentrated in the west, Haru would seize a one-time opportunity to take back democratic territory and begin transforming Astanir into a true democracy again.

During the night of the QASIC summer offensive, the free army would rally in the border, along with what little armoured vehicles and tanks they had managed to keep hold of since the Kuwalkti incident. The army would be a mere 5,000 men in size, nothing compared to the might of QASIC, but nonetheless the operation would go ahead. Haru figured that since most QASIC forces were away fighting in the west, the free army might stand a chance.

They would cross the border in 5 separate units of 1,000 men each. These units would spread out to capture as much land as possible in the north, before concentrating towards Kuwalkti. They would use at armoured vehicles and tanks as cover, as well as the natural environment due to their lack of air capabilities. They would have a few drones to spare which had been brought with them after the escape form Kuwalkti, which would now be deployed to take out targets further afield, to reduce the amount of resistance the main army would face when moving forwards.

The operation, nicknamed operation Lahou hama would be the free armys first and possibly only action directly against the Democratic army. Arono would pray for its success

[spoiler=and old man and an old lady]18 de setembro de 2025, dois dias antes do Dia Da Independência.

Sereviana, uma cidade relativamente pequena localizada no oeste do império nos Pampas, abrigava cerca de 47 mil habitantes, em um bairro mais do interior da cidade, um bar em uma esquina com uma grade externa que era bloqueada por uma lona que servia de sombra a quem bebia lá na frente, o bar era de uma tinta vermelha com listras amarelas desgastadas pelo tempo, e no topo dizendo "Vento Virado", o nome do bar, o movimento era relativamente baixo, não mais que alguns bêbados balbuciando coisas enquanto jogam mais uns goles de álcool pela garganta.
Raul Montenegro entrou, a entrada um portão de aço que se puxado para baixo, fechava, o instrutor estava vestido de forma simples, uma camisa social com listras de tons esverdeados e calças pretas largas, o interior era simples, paredes de ladrilho com circulos amarelos, pareciam que estavam sob constante limpeza, as mesas e cadeiras não eram nada chiques, simples e feitas de plástico ,geralmente amarelas, mas algumas eram azuis ou vermelhas, as mesas de plástico tinham alguns homens de barriga grande com até 4 garrafas , ou mulheres mais de idade que bebiam e lanchavam, ele se dirigiu até onde o dono do bar sentava, um banco simples, e a bancada onde a que preparava as bebidas, ficava, o dono, vestido com uma simples regata azul e jeans mais neutras, e uma aparência de talvez 70 anos e cabelos grisalhos, ajustou os óculos e olhou para Raul com um sorriso, enquanto bebia mais um copo.
"Então você veio Raul ...há quanto tempo."
Montenegro o acenou em saudação brevemente, e se sentou, a mulher do bar, uma senhora de meia idade com cabelo preto curto que ao menos mantinha a cor original, vestindo uma camisa leve com detalhes da natureza verdes, pele branca e que segurava um cigarro em mãos.
"E o Társio hein? Segue na liderança da sua organização é?"
Ele perguntou em tom informal, Raul relaxou os ombros e colocou o ombro sobre a bancada e disse:
"O mesmo de sempre, Duarte, ele segue lá no alto."
Duarte suspirou, em certa decepção audível, ele começou:
"Hmph, o velho segue lá?"
Ele apontou para Raul, e gesticulou algo para a mulher do balcão, falando:
"María."
A bartender entendeu, e logo sorriu de canto e disse, enquanto estalava os dedos.
"Silêncio."
Aos arredores de repente ficaram em silêncio, não estavam em silêncio total, é claro, mas para quem estava na pequena bolha azul criada por María, o som de fora não existia, e para os de fora, não podiam escutar nada lá, María comentou com um sorriso e voz suave.
"Borrachos não prestam atenção nisso."
Raul sorriu e olhou para María com aprovação, e então se virou para Raul, finalmente começando:
"os únicos que podem criar essa nova era é quem está vivendo ela, Társio já perdeu sua vez Raul, você acha que será você ou Maciel quem irão mover a nação para a nova era? Será Casdanel? Serão seus classes 1 do CNT? Ou será o velho Társio que está lá desde 1989 liderando essa organização?"
Raul ficou em um longo silêncio após as palavras de Duarte, ele pegou um copo o qual María o ofereceu, uma cachaça artesanal e bebeu o líquido âmbar, e então respondeu.
"Está falando mal de Társio? Foi ele que fez o Estatuto de 89 entrar em vigor e proteger gente como nós, foi ele quem nos deu um lar..."
Duarte sorriu, não com desdém, mas certa convicção, e disse:
"Isso foi em 89 Raul, estamos em 2025, esses tessitores que Társio protegeu hoje são adultos."
Ele bebeu um gole longo de cachaça e então prosseguiu, encarando agora Raul profundamente nos olhos.
"Eu me lembro de você, lá em 2009, após o Casdanel ter derrubado você e o Antenor como se fossem brinquedos, você havia sumido do CNT por 4 anos, e onde estava nesses 4 anos? Comigo, você não pode defender Társio, Raul, quando você mesmo rejeitou ele em 2009 e quis vir até mim para lhe ensinar."
De repente Raul apenas ficou imóvel, com a garrafa em sua mão parecendo pesar, e o álcool em sua garganta arder, ele olhou para baixo e falou mais baixo, repetindo:
"Quatro anos..."
Ele levantou o rosto após pensar mais nisso, e então respondeu:
"Quatro anos em um treino com o homem que me fez o segundo mais forte do CNT, quatro anos nos pampas treinando com o mestre de Fyssicon e a mestra da eneritae."
Ele fez um breve gesto apontando para Raul e María respectivamente, mas então questionou.
"Mas, ainda não consigo entender, por que você é María não quiseram fazer uma mudança? Sei que passaram todos esses anos isolados, mas ainda com o CNT respeitando suas escolhas, sabendo que não são ameaças..."
María então recostou os cotovelos na bancada, e soprou o cigarro em Raul, um cheiro de nicotina sendo soprado diretamente em sua face, Raul recuou instintivamente com a fumaça em seu rosto, mas então voltou a prestar atenção e ela então , que então respondeu pelo seu companheiro.
"Pois eu e Duarte já estamos ultrapassados, seria hipocrisia de nossa parte, trocar a velha guarda por alguém da mesma geração, não?"
Duarte respondeu com um sorriso de aprovação, e bebeu mais um copo, então olhou para Raul novamente, e o falou um tom que emanava serenidade.
"Você não precisa ter tanta pressa, Raul, agora isso está com vocês, vocês da segunda geração, são os que manterão o [i] equilíbrio [/i] até que os [i]sonhadores[/i] possam cumprir seus sonhos."
Ele deu uma piscadela para Raul de forma descontraída enquanto terminava o seu copo de álcool, e finalizou.
"Com isso dito, Raul, por que não me traz uns dos seus moleques do CNT pra eu treinar como eu fiz com você? Seria bom ter uma companhia além da minha esposa e uns bêbados..."
Raul ficou imóvel por um momento, pôs os dedos na bancada de madeira arranhada e os tamborilhou nas tábuas danificadas, como se pensasse no que ambos acabaram de o falar e toda longa história contada, finalmente, ergueu os olhos, os óculos revelando finalmente seus olhos castanhos, e então disse:
"Um dos meus moleques é velho?"
Ele repetiu, enquanto ajustou o próprio óculos.
"Então você quer um diamante bruto pra polir, assim como você fez comigo? Quer um soldado pra moldar assim como eu?"
Duarte sorriu para Raul, pondo o copo na bancada, que logo María encheu novamente mais do líquido âmbar.
"Ah sim, exatamente isso Raul, agora que o fantasma de 2009 voltou para os assombrar, você parece perceber que não é só técnica que vai vencer uma força da natureza..."
Raul, apesar de ter compreendido as palavras de seu mestre, ainda sentia uma pontada de dúvida, e então questionou:
"Mas...após todos esses anos, será que ainda poderá conseguir..."
A pergunta pairou no ar, em um gesto breve, moveu os dedos indicador e médio , os levantando para cima com os outros fechados, com a cachaça em seu copo se solidificando em um bloco sólido, parecendo um gelo amarelo, nada complexo, mas ainda um sinal que ele ainda poderia fazer algo.
"A técnica envelhece? Sim, enferruja? Com certeza, mas nunca some."
Raul ficou em silêncio mais uma vez pela demonstração breve de poder , enquanto via seu mestre desfazendo o bloco sólido em líquido novamente e bebendo mais um gole, e finalmente disse
"Victor Henrique Duarte de Oliveira..."
O nome chamou a atenção de Duarte e María, ambos recostando os braços na bancada, encostados um ao outro em uma pose quase igual de espera.
"Um mero cutelo bruto ainda, e que foi derrotado pelo revolucionário após seu retorno há 6 dias..."
María então sorriu, e apagou seu cigarro em um pequeno pote ao lado, e disse com um sorriso surgindo em seu rosto.
"Um cutelo pode abrir mais caminhos que uma espada refinada, e algo quebrado sempre pode ser... reconstruído."
Duarte assentiu com María, e então se virou para Raul, e o disse, pondo a mão em seu ombro.
"Então o traga para mim, por [b]um mês [/b], e ele voltará melhor que todos os anos em que ele esteve no CNT..."
Raul pensou por um momento, olhou no rosto de seu mestre, focando em seus olhos verdes, pensou que isso iria contra a idéia de Társio ou o CNT, mas, mesmo Raul já havia feito aquilo, por que não? Finalmente, ele aceitou, e pôs a mão sob a de Duarte, um risco calculado sim, mas era importante, ele ajustou os óculos e concordou:
"Então que seja, um mês você terá, Duarte, não se preocupe com Társio, eu sei que ele o respeita, e sem dúvidas aceitará essa proposta."
Sem cerimônia, ele se levantou, María sorriu e desfez a bolha de silêncio ao redor deles, retornando a sonata de bêbados e fofocas, eles sorriram enquanto viam Raul saindo do bar, até dando uma risada quando Raul olhou para os lados de perguntando de que lado de onde veio, e vendo ele indo para o lugar oposto.

[b]16 de setembro de 2025.[/b]
Usando um ônibus que pegaram em uma cidade próxima, Gustavo Quid e Isabella Rubim chegaram até Sereviana,a intenção era passarem o final de semana lá, e então viajarem mais longe para fugirem do registro ou quaisquer um que quisesse tirar sua autonomia.
"Finalmente estamos longe!"
Gustavo comentou enquanto caminhava pela calçada ao lado de Rubim, cujo cabelo vermelho tremulava contra o vento, ela o respondeu:
"...é algum tempo de descanso antes da tempestade."
Gustavo revirou os olhos conforme sua parceira vivia sendo pessimista, eles chegaram até a esquina de um bar simples, e surpreendentemente vazio, leram lá em cima "Vento Virado", Rubim falou, puxando Gustavo com ela.
"Vamos ir comer um pouco, a viagem foi longa."
Gustavo e Bella passaram entre os bêbados da varanda até chegarem no bar, sentaram-se a frente do balcão riscado, o qual atrás estava María lavando algumas garrafas e Duarte sentado lendo um jornal mais atrás, Bella foi a primeira a fazer:
"Boa tarde!"
A voz soou até um tanto formal para o ambiente descontraído, María se virou de costas e cumprimentou:
"Boa tarde visitantes!"
E Duarte abaixou o jornal e se levantou, dizendo o mesmo para os dois, ainda mais falando:
"O que traria vocês dais até esse fim de mundo eu pergunto?"
Gustavo deu um sorriso descontraído, mas que não chegou até os olhos, ele respondeu rapidamente.
"Escapando do barulho da capital, é isso."
Seu tom parecia um pouco apressado, como se tentasse explicar algo que não precisava demais, algo que o casal estranhou um pouco, mas eles fingiram não notar, María então entregou um pote simples de batatas fritas murchas mas que pareciam saborosas apesar da aparência pouco chamativa, ela os disse:
"Vocês não são tão discretos não crianças?"
Gustavo imediatamente gaguejou com as palavras de Maria, e balbuciou palavras;
"O...oque..."
Duarte que observava tudo então serviu um copo de bebida e bebeu, não era cachaça, mas cerveja, ele serviu e bebeu, após terminar colocou o copo vazio na mesa e os explicou.
"O cabelo vermelho longo, e o cabelo loiro com rastros de eneritae...eles não são sutis."
Logo Raul após terminar e deixar suas palavras no ar, Rubim já agarrando Gustavo pelo pulso para saírem dali, Maria continuou o que seu marido dizia;
"Não se preocupem crianças...não somos do CNT, nem de nenhum lado, só estamos aqui, nos dois."
A revelação acalentou a preocupação da dupla não registrada, que relaxou um pouco mais, e eles mantiveram uma conversa relativamente calma, longe da tensão inicial, falando mais do que deviam de si, mas os mais velhos não pareciam julgadores, María então olhou para Gustavo, seus olhos azuis encarando o rosto do jovem, ela aproximou sem permissão os dedos e retirou um pequeno pedaço de batata que estava em sua bochecha, e pôs em sua boca, dizendo:
"Aqui, está meio sujo..."
Ela então sorriu, deixando Gustavo um pouco sem palavras, e até meio corado, enquanto dizia:
"Ah, senhorita María...quão gentil..."
Um silêncio dominou a sala, não pelas técnicas de Maria, mas o simples ato "gentil", que deixou Gustavo um tanto desconcertado, finalmente, Duarte quebrou o silêncio com um sorriso e uma brincadeira.
"Ah sim, ela é gentil, relaxem, depois de 50 anos casado, mesmo eu aprendi que não adianta tentar lutar com isso."
María deu um tapa no ombro de Duarte, um gesto de afeto, e até um pouco dramático, mas então ela virou de volta aos dois jovens.
"Mas, o meu velho aqui tem um ponto...um cabelo loiro e um vermelho assim tão... vibrantes."
Ela disse observando Rubim e Gustavo bem com seus olhos, e então prosseguiu.
"Podem até passar despercebidos em uma cidade grande, já aqui no interior? É fácil diferenciar."
Duarte colocou o antebraço no balcão e então continuou o que sua companheira estava falando:
"Vocês dois não são realmente discretos, não importa o quanto tentem parecer, sua aparência os entrega muito bem, s quando não conseguirem mais se esconder? Quando as cansarem de correr? Farão o que?"
Ele questionou, um silêncio dominou a dupla não registrada, Bella até tentou falar algo, mas nem ela pensou, María então sorriu, tirando um pequeno papel de baixo do balcão, e oferecendo para Rubim.
"Se querem tanto alguma proteção,  podem usar o quarto de hóspedes, só não façam bagunça, fica do lado do meu quarto e do meu Duarte."
O silêncio que se seguiu ao convite de María era pesado, carregado de desconfiança e, por baixo dela, um vislumbre frágil de esperança. A oferta era simples, mas nas entrelinhas, era tudo o que eles precisavam: um teto, um esconderijo e, mais importante, um momento de paz.
Gustavo olhou para Bella, seus olhos castanhos buscando orientação nos verdes determinados de sua companheira. Ele via a exaustão neles, a mesma que sentia em seus próprios ossos. Correr era cansativo. Sempre olhar por cima do ombro era um fardo que pesava a cada dia.
Bella, por sua vez, estudou o rosto de María. Não havia mentira ali, apenas uma oferta genuína, talvez até um pouco de diversão em ter a companhia de jovens tão... elétricos. Ela então olhou para Duarte. Mesmo Bella estava cansada de correr, o homem mais velho a encarou de volta, seus olhos verdes parecendo ver através de todas as suas defesas, entendendo o cálculo por trás de sua hesitação.
" É um quarto, não uma gaiola", 
disse Duarte, como se lesse seus pensamentos. Ele pegou o copo e encheu com mais cerveja, até terminar a garrafa e beber tudo
. "A porta não tem tranca. A janela dá para os pinheiros. Se mudarem de ideia no meio da noite, pulem e sumam. nao vamos nos importar, é sério"
Foi essa última frase que quebrou a resistência de Bella. A promessa de que a saída estava sempre aberta, era algo  tentador.
"Só uma semana...uma só semana."
Bella disse se rendendo a tentação, e dando o papel para María novamente, um mero papel amassado e rabiscado, ela pegou o papel com um sorriso e o guardou novamente, enquanto Duarte pegava de seu bolso um molho de chaves velhas e entregava para Gustavo.
"Vai na porta atrás do balcão, sobe as escadas, vai ter uma porta vermelha lá a sua esquerda, é lá, não espere nada chique, se escutarem algum barulho no banheiro as 6 é por que eu acordo cedo."
Os dois assentiram, e pegaram a chave, ao subirem as escadas e seguirem o caminho falado, chegaram ao quarto, era simples, uma cama de casal ,armário de madeira meio arranhado e mais velho que os dois juntos, Gustavo foi olhar pela janela, uma pequena mata de araucárias como dito por Duarte, e uma queda de talvez 3 metros, ele se jogou na cama, sentindo o colchão macio contra ele, Bella fez o mesmo, sentindo um...alívio, e talvez até paz, ela disse para Gustavo.
"Eles são excêntricos? Sim...mas ao menos confio neles..."
Bella comentou, enquanto Gustavo apenas acenava em concordância, o cabelo vermelho dela se espalhando pela cama.
Enquanto estavam lá em cima, já na parte do bar em si, María comentava com Duarte:
"Acha que eles ficarão mesmo ali?"
Duarte sorriu para sua esposa, colocando o dedo suavemente no queixo dela, a respondendo.
"Sem dúvidas, capaz de ficarem mesmo até mais que uma semana, quem sabe talvez possamos treinar eles...os dois parecem pensar que só há dois caminhos pelo visto."
María apreciou o toque suave, e respondeu com um olhar gentil para Duarte, o respondendo:
"Você realmente quer um pouco de ação em sua vida né querido...mas, e quando Raul voltar?"
Ela advertiu, e Duarte a respondeu se forma imediata, como se já esperasse:
"O CNT respeita nossa neutralidade, e Raul tem uma dívida que não pagou conosco ainda Marí...se o CNT batesse em nossa porta, ele estaria disposto a trair a própria instituição se necessário."

The ultimatum expired. Nobody believed that threatening violence would make the coalition back down, for they'd already been tear-gassed and sometimes shot at. As a result, High War-Priest Wojciech Saebaldr granted permission for the Tallislandic military to respond in force to restore order in all cities nationwide. 

The immediate concern was to relieve pressure off of Hoscbus and Jaerlic, two crucial cities that were surrounded by coalition-held lands. 20 IC-7 APCs were dispatched alongside 13 Śu-72 attack helicopters, and 12,000 soldiers. Their goals were to regain control of the Ofenhind peninsula, starting with Lukylod and working their way south to Ironlorkston. 

An equally sized force would be sent to Górzynka, to retake the Eyjafjollum region from the Young Tallialandics part of the coalition, although this group included 12 T-11 attack jets part of the "Sfinks" squadron, and 2 C-2 Eagle aircraft under the names AWACS Chefrena and AWACS Cheeseburger. 

On September 9th, only a day before the ultimatum was set to expire, Kjersti Stennes from a temporary hideout in Miswig, gave orders to attack the Office of the Navy in Karwbridc, and to seize all equipment from Karwbridc Harbor. The Office was not a single building but rather several across the naval installation at Karwbridc, and included a barracks building, an academy building, an administrative building, armory, and the ports themselves. 

Each building had been fortified in anticipation of an assault, with local police forces from the city and surrounding regions rallying here at the Office to fight alongside better trained soldiers. Machine Gun positions, sandbag walls, abandoned police cars, jersey barriers, anything the Office could get it's hands on they used to turn itself into a fortress. And that's not even mentioning the ships docked within the ports.

The main ship docked was the flagship BMW Baptism of Morawik aircraft carrier, containing 16 R-15 Orzeł STOL fighters. Additionally, 8 patrol boats, 2 corvettes, 3 cruisers, a destroyer, and a frigate had arrived to defend the base. Not including the crew of the ships, around 6,000 were ready to defend the Office, of which roughly a sixth were local law enforcement officers.

The attacking Anti-Principalists had managed to convince 40,000 to march on the Office, equipping toughly half of those 40k with weapons dropped through shipments from United Hydronia. With little to no ammunition however, most would be forced to use a single magazine before tossing the weapon or picking up something the Tallislandics had dropped. 

Michał Grabarczyk, a Karwbridc local was assigned with leading the charge into the Office, and spoke outside of the gates to the makeshift fortress for several hours giving words of encouragement to the protestors and rioters that had gathered. 

By five P.M the automatic daylight-sensor lights of the Office kicked on, which signaled that the attack was to begin. "The Cudzothko never cared for democracy, it was only ever justification for their oppression of true Tallialandics. This faux democracy and their oppression ends today!"

 Those were the final words spoken by Grabarczyk before the gates to the Office were breached by rioters, to which Tallislandic soldiers reluctantly opened fire upon. Atleast thirty were cut down in the first charge, hit by standard 556 infantry rounds and even the 12.7mm armor piercing rounds. It was a gory affair, rioters charging past the corpses toward the soldiers and officers like zombies, some being beaten to death and others being chained up. The Young Tallislandics in the crowd returned fire to rooftop snipers, detaching KMDK machine guns to pelt snipers with armor piercing rounds. 

The single Mikavonov frigate stationed at the Office loaded it's cannon to fire gas shells at the rioters hoping to drive them back, only for them to begin donning homemade masks made from bandanas and other clothes. Subsequently, panicked, the lead officer granted permission to load cluster munitions, which were fired without gaining permission from the rest of the stationed fleet.

Dozens killed instantly, dozens more injured or filled with shrapnel. Even several Tallislandic soldiers were killed by the cluster munitions. The advance of the rebels was indeed halted, if only for a couple seconds. Enraged at the countless deaths of their comrades, the rebels charged for the armory, intending to take the rocket launchers there to destroy the ships docked at the port. 

The rebels grinded through the lobby of the armory, fighting intense room-to-room combat against the soldiers. Naturally the soldiers had an advantage in training, but there was simply too many for them to deal with. All of the soldiers in the armory were rounded up, and tortured into teaching the rebels there how to operate the weaponry. 

To limit what could be taken, the Tallislandic navy again took the insane decision to fire an anti-ship missile at the building to prevent the rebels from seizing the armament in the building, killing around 3,000 individuals including their own allies. 

This was enough to warrant both the surrender of soldiers in the barracks and the academy building due to grief, and the orders from Kjersti Stennes to [i]send in the reinforcements.[/i]

Gründer Industries had been a close ally to Stennes and her Young Tallisland, and had given some of it's newest equipment to the AWN to test out in Nevonia and in Flousech, including the X-00 5th generation stealth fighter and XB-00 stealth bomber variant. Eight XB-00s took off from Brëckaloo, accompanied by twelve X-00s from Aardbuer in the Azraël squadron.

These aircraft bore the symbols of the Free Tallisland movement: a triangle with seven stars in it, and some Gründer iconography. By morning of September 10, the Azraël squadron arrived in style. Anti-ship missiles were launched from 4 of the XB-00s, disabling both cruisers, and two corvettes. An additional two XB-00s dropped fuel-air-explosive-bombs on the deck of the Baptism of Morawik, preventing hostile aircraft from taking off to put up a resistance.

Emboldened by the friendly air-power, some of the soldiers that had switched sides joined the rebellion in making the final charge into the administrative building of the office. Again, their training was dwarfed by that of their enemy, especially now that they were fighting the special forces contingent assigned to the protection of the High Naval-priest.

What advantage they did hold was quickly replaced by increasingly better armed rebels and even some deserters, who swept through every floor of the building before finally taking the High Naval-priest into custody. The rebellion stormed the docked ships after, forcing them all to surrender or be shot.

Michał Grabarczyk, assigned to administer the office now by the Coalition, did his best to prevent war crimes being committed against the prisoners, to around 50% effectiveness. Two firing squad executions were arranged without his permission, to which the perpetrators were quickly chained alongside those they had just attempted to kill. The decision was made by Grabarczyk to move all soldiers in his custody to the barracks and lock it off, patrolling the building routinely and making something of a temporary prison.

The following day, September 11th 2026, Holy President Clifford Prisk made a national statement regarding the seizure of the Naval Command Office. "Tallislandic heroes defeated the pagans, dethroned the monarchists, toppled the Islamists, saved Christian values, upheld Lusandric principles and chased down the terrorists to the very ends of Erene. We are now in the process of defeating the radicals the communists, the anarchists, the ethno-nationalists, the looters and people who in many instances have absolutely no clue what they are doing. Those that carried out unholy and gruesome attacks against our faithful troops in Karwbridc will face the full wrath of God, I can assure all Tallislandics and even those abroad, who would see myself and my people as weak. But know this, Erene. Tallisland will remain as the longest lasting democracy in this planet so long as I live, and I shan't allow these leftist-paganistic-eco-terrorists to subvert the greatest Christian state in the history of Erene." 

By now, a civil war was truly underway. Smaller troop movements would be made around Górzynka by the government to encircle rebel movements, and the AWN would properly enter the war by seizing the Szbulban islands of Szczepanik, Drzewiecki, Czochralski, Kotschy, and Pasha. Their goal? Seize the straits, allow for supplies and manpower to be siphoned into Ofenhind.
